author: Harmonia[m2-ca1148a0]
method:
Stage-A experimental-opportunity triage of every cut fossil (HARM-46).  2026-09-18.

Harmonia[m2-ca1148a0]. A FEASIBILITY MAP, not a ranking (C8: no LLM selector):
every row is derived by fixed predicates over two committed records --
nyx/atlas/fossils/<id>.json (the cut) and techne/fossils/specimens/<id>/
record.json (the body, its world, its run receipts). No judgement of
importance is made anywhere in this file; a reader who wants an order sorts
the table by a column of their choosing.

Predicates (all mechanical):
    world           Techne run_classification + runner + image; NOW if an ok run
                    receipt exists, else the classification's own word
    oracle          UPSTREAM_TESTS (test_classification UPSTREAM_TESTS_PASS),
                    SMOKE_ONLY (TECHNE_SMOKE_HARNESS_PASS: execution grade, narrow),
                    DECLARED_EXAMPLE (record.example.output states an expected
                    output), NONE
    REPRODUCTION    feasible iff the world is NOW (a run receipt ok=True exists)
    MUTATION        feasible iff REPRODUCTION and >= 1 ACCEPTED organ whose
                    source_boundary is not UNKNOWN (a named place to edit)
    NEW_EXPERIMENT  candidate iff the record carries a behavioral_entry_point
                    (Techne's declared knob) or the cut states >= 1 pressure
    consumer        THEOPHRASTUS_CELL if MUTATION feasible (an organ with a boundary
                    in a running world is an ablation cell);
                    SFE_VIA_ARCHAEON if NEW_EXPERIMENT and the world is NOW (a
                    parameter sweep is an SFE experiment kind);
                    NESTOR_PRIMORDIAL if the world is not NOW (reading-level
                    receipt only); several may apply and all are listed

The 39-cut scope of the 09-17 ask is superseded by the atlas itself: at
origin/main 22d5c7432 every one of the 107 cut fossils carries a cut record
(79 re-saved on 09-17 under nyx.atlas/1-provenance). All 107 are mapped.
Writes TRIAGE_STAGE_A_2026-09-18.json and .md beside this file.

rows.behavioral_entry_point: change the setpoint (step), inject a load disturbance, or set aggressive gains (Kp/Ki high) to drive it UNSTABLE -- the harness does the last as a pathological-
compare the wait schedules of expo vs full_jitter over many clients: identical versus spread
script different rationing policies into hammurabi.bas's INPUTs and compare the ten-year outcomes
shrink NUM_BHT_ENTRIES to force aliasing; toggle GSHARE_ENABLE; compare misprediction traces on the same branch stream
netstat -s before/after a loopback transfer; a second emulated VAX over a lossy Ethernet relay is the boundary (see record notes)
the same controlled pressure as the 4.3 tape, so the two kernels' netstat -s counters can be set side by side (interpretation is Nyx's)
read tcp_output.c/tcp_timer.c: no cwnd, no ssthresh; compare with the same files at BSD-4_3_Tahoe
the dup-ack counter (t_dupacks) and fast-recovery branch in tcp_input.c; absent in Tahoe
diff tcp_output.c/tcp_input.c against BSD-4_2: snd_cwnd, snd_ssthresh, the slow-start branch in tcp_input's ack processing
allocate many small blocks then a large one, freeing in an adversarial order, to induce fragmentation failure in the bounded arena
increase radamsa's case count or nesting depth (CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT); watch rejected vs parsed vs crashed
run CBL0006 (conditional totals) and CBL0033 on the same data; corrupt one COMP-3 field in a copy of the data and watch the report
the tests' contention cases; drop acceptor replies and watch proposal numbers climb
compress the same corpus with compact, ncompress-5.0 (LZW) and gzip-1.2.4 (DEFLATE) and record ratio and time: the lineage's selection pressure made measurable
run a spinlock validate binary with more threads than cores; switch spinlock implementation (ticket vs MCS vs anderson) and compare
the shipped transcript is a behavioural record; compare its replies against the MAD-SLIP original on the same inputs
run the known-answer vectors; vary rounds to watch avalanche; the failure is economic (keyspace size), not structural
checkpoint at count N, kill, restart: the first printed count after restart is the observation
tighten a constraint or shorten the solve deadline until the receding-horizon problem becomes infeasible
feed matrices with clustered or degenerate eigenvalues and watch convergence; compare rs against LAPACK dsyev on the same matrix
feed inputs that hit vs miss the DOCTOR keywords and watch reflection vs the memory/none-keyword fallbacks; swap the script to change the 'personality' with no
compare the original MAD rule set against the reconstruction's behaviour on the CACM dialogue
shrink nwalkers to 2*ndim or stretch the target's condition number; watch acceptance and autocorrelation time
give it a harder algebra problem (e.g. a ring identity) and watch generated/processed clause counts and time; vary --auto vs a fixed strategy
perturb a constant in a copy of one routine and re-run make check: the validation names the routine that drifted
change the learning rate or hidden-layer size, or corrupt the training labels, and watch convergence/generalisation change
vary reader count and hold time; switch the kind attribute; measure writer acquisitions
reshape (rho) an array to a non-conforming shape and watch the error; vary the outer-product operator's function
run each named case; compare the goroutine dump; edit nothing (the fixtures are the fossil)
vary -1..-9 (the lazy-match effort knob in deflate.c) and record ratio/time; compare with compact and ncompress on one corpus
the tests' unreachable peers and timeouts; shrink ProbeTimeout / SuspicionMult and watch false positives
raise the corruption level of the cue, or store MORE patterns than ~0.14N, and watch recall fail into spurious attractors
the forgetting factor lambda (0.8 in the script) and the initial covariance p: the adaptation speed knob
the adaptation gain Gamma and the filter bandwidth in the script
write without closing cleanly (leave the .log) and reopen; vary write_buffer_size to force memtable flushes and compactions
raise the injected error rate past the correction bound in the tests and watch decode failures appear
run BP on a loopy .fg (tests/ ships several) with different damping/update schedules and record convergence
factor matrices of growing n with LINPACK dgefa and LAPACK dgetrf in the same process and compare time/MFLOPS as n crosses cache sizes
the two files ARE the before/after of a documented redesign: CUBIC's loss-triggered cubic window vs BBR's explicit bandwidth+RTT probing. Read them side by side
